name: ARKK Food Company
old_description: ARKK specializes in identifying a need in the market and bringing unique products to market to fulfill that need.
about:
ARKK Food Company operates from Bloomfield Township, Michigan, where it has spent more than a decade developing, acquiring, and representing transformative food brands. The company was built on the premise of identifying unmet market needs and bringing unique products to market to fulfill them, though a specific founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company manages a portfolio of seven brands spanning protein, hydration, and prepared foods. Its Pennsylvania Food Corp division runs a high-volume food manufacturing and assembly facility that produces sandwiches, breakfast bowls, entrée bowls, and handles packaging. Other brands include Wahlburgers for retail burgers, Sonoma Grille for premium ham, Skinny Butcher for double-breaded chicken, Simply Essentials for Black Angus beef, Maple 3 for maple water, and Envisible for supply-chain visibility technology. ARKK reports its products are stocked in over 12,000 retail locations nationwide, and its Farm to Family Grant program has distributed 14.5 million food boxes and sourced 43.5 million pounds of produce from eight states since May 2020.

ARKK serves the retail grocery channel, supplying the largest U.S. retailers, and partners with government and nonprofit relief programs such as the Farm to Family Grant. Its customer base includes national retail chains, food-service distributors, and consumers seeking premium, sustainable protein and beverage options.

The company says it differentiates itself by blending creativity and strategy to craft iconic brands, elevating traditional food items through innovation, and providing end-to-end solutions from product development and sustainability consulting to traceability and consumer engagement.
